name: sfx_board
description: ScaleFX board-side framework — `BoardOf<TBoard>` CRTP composer with static port descriptors. server/: BoardServer<...Policies> variadic composer, BoardServicePolicy (universal lifecycle/identify/status/I2C-scan), PacketReader/COBS framer, StreamWriter, PortRegistry (servo / PWM / H-bridge ports with optional sensors), PortServicePolicy (raw port access + enumeration), RoleServicePolicy (runtime role attachment + dispatch), BoardOf<TBoard> CRTP base. roles/: LedAnimator, DcMotorRole, BiDcMotorRole, HeaterRole, ServoActuatorRole, RcPwmInputRole — runtime-attachable functionality on top of the port layer.
